newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to use old electricity prices for Feb CPI.
newsitem.headline: Italy to use old electricity prices for Feb CPI.

text.p: Italian statistics office Istat said on Friday it would not take into account a recent cut in electricity tariffs when it calculates February inflation.
Earlier on Friday, the price reductions were suspended by an administrative court until April 4, pending final approval.

Eleven Italian cities, which released preliminary February inflation figures on Thursday and Friday, took the electricity cuts into account. The data pointed to year-on-year inflation of 2.2 percent, down 0.1 percent month-on-month.
Istat said the electricity tariff cuts had helped depress prices in the preliminary data by some 0.2 percent.
One official source, who declined to be named, said he believed inflation would be around 2.3-2.4 percent year-on-year this month, without taking into account the electricity price reductions.
Istat is due to release the official February inflation data on March 4. Inflation in January was 2.6 percent year-on-year. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
